parameters.query: INSERT INTO failed_jobs (execution_id, workflow_name, node_name, error_msg) VALUES (NULLIF('={{ (($json.execution || {}).id || "") }}', '')::int, '={{ ((($json.workflow || {}).name || "unknown")).toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '={{ (((($json.execution || {}).lastNodeExecuted) || "unknown")).toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '={{ JSON.stringify((($json.execution || {}).error || $json.error || {"message": "unknown error"})).replace(/'/g, "''") }}');
